steps.text: Before: this Order Hub runs on community Spring 5.3.18. The demo catalog marks representative Spring CVEs as VULNERABLE — not production-ready for this story.
steps.visual:
Spring 5.3.18 (community)
CVE catalog → VULNERABLE
App still takes orders — but the pin is the problem

steps.text: Lightwell remediates that same Spring line (5.3.18.rhlw-00010) and you pull it through Nexus. No application code rewrite.

Nexus: lightwell-java-remediated
maven-public looks there first
5.3.18 → 5.3.18.rhlw-00010

steps.text: After: rebuild with the lightwell profile (README Stage 2), restart the JAR. Spring shows .rhlw and the CVE catalog flips to REMEDIATED — production-ready for this demo.
steps.visual:
Stop server → README Stage 2 → new JAR
Spring CVEs → REMEDIATED
Same Order Hub, remediated dependency
